summary: Push fan-out feature verified end-to-end. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest cases PASS (see /app/backend/tests/test_push_broadcast.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). /api/register-push persists device in db.push_devices via upsert on user_id BEFORE calling upstream (verified via direct Mongo read after each POST); upsert idempotency confirmed (single row per user_id, latest device_token wins); Pydantic 422 on invalid body. With EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder the upstream 401 correctly surfaces as HTTP 500 on /register-push (per playbook) but the row is still persisted. /api/trigger-alert ALWAYS returns HTTP 200 with push_delivered:false and push_error='EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' — verified with triggeredBy=dev-A (recipients excludes source, matches count from db), body {} (recipients = all devices), and {triggeredBy, magnitude:7.1} (200, push_delivered false, status='broadcast'). Legacy /api/status POST + GET still work (id, timestamp, client_name preserved; created row appears in GET list). Root /api/ still returns {message:'Hello World'}. FRONTEND E2E (390x844, geolocation Mriehel 35.8916/14.4658/10, page.route intercepting POST safequake/api/status AND EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api/trigger-alert): after tapping trigger-alert-btn → alert screen mounts, EXACTLY 1 POST to /api/trigger-alert fires with body {triggeredBy:'qg-...', magnitude:6.4, distance_km:12, intensity:'VII'} (triggeredBy non-empty string, magnitude is number), and 1 not_responding POST to safequake fires ahead of it — trigger-alert does NOT block navigation. Tapping im-safe-btn produces exactly 1 safe POST to safequake with warm GPS fix (35.8916,14.4658,±10m), alert-success-toast appears, and app auto-navigates back to Home (verified by final screenshot). Order verified: [not_responding, safe]. CODE-LEVEL CHECKS all PASS: server.py uses httpx.AsyncClient(base_url='https://integrations.emergentagent.com', headers X-Push-Key=EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY); register-push upserts on user_id BEFORE upstream; send_push chunks at CHUNK=100 and raises ValueError if title/message missing; trigger_alert wraps send_push in try/except HTTPException/Exception so response is always 200 with push_delivered flag; _layout.tsx has module-scope Notifications.setNotificationHandler guarded by Platform!=='web' + android channel 'default' with AndroidImportance.MAX + addNotificationResponseReceivedListener + getLastNotificationResponseAsync in useEffect (web-guarded) both routing to data.action_url||'/alert'; push.ts uses Notifications.getDevicePushTokenAsync (not Expo token) and POSTs to `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/register-push` with ios.allowCriticalAlerts:false; reminders.ts uses interruptionLevel:'timeSensitive' and allowCriticalAlerts:false; index.tsx handleTrigger calls postStatus({status:'not_responding'}) then broadcastAlert() then reminder setup (fire-and-forget) then router.push('/alert'); app.json expo.plugins has bare ['expo-notifications', {}] with no iosCriticalAlerts flag. REGRESSION: home hero, 4 tip cards (drop/cover/hold on/after), sticky trigger-alert-btn, system-status-banner all render; alert screen metrics render without label overlap; iteration_5 already confirmed dismiss cancels reminders without POSTing safe.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY defaults to literal 'placeholder' if env var missing — matches playbook. Consider: when key is exactly 'placeholder' skip the upstream call altogether to avoid emitting known-fail requests in preview (small optimisation; behaviour is still correct today because send_push swallows the resulting 500).

server.py: register-push returns {'status':'registered'} with declared status_code=201 on success path but on upstream 401 raises HTTPException(500) — E1 confirms this is per playbook contract. Not a bug.
index.tsx handleTrigger fires broadcastAlert() unawaited so router.push('/alert') is not blocked — verified by E2E (nav happens immediately). Intentional.

Expo web preview logs: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' and 'shadow* deprecated, use boxShadow'. Both are expected on web preview, do not affect native builds. No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) detected.
seed_data_creation: 3 push_devices rows per test-run with TEST_dev-{A,B,C}-<uuid6> user_ids; cleaned up in fixture teardown via db.push_devices.delete_many.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend push fan-out and frontend broadcast wiring are green. Real Expo push delivery cannot be validated on web preview (getDevicePushTokenAsync throws on web) — needs a native build with real EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_push_broadcast.py can be re-used as regression. Note: tests assume MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars are populated (falls back to mongodb://localhost:27017/test_database).
